### DetailsOf {#DetailsOf}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">type</span> <code class="sdk-qual">DetailsOf</code></div>

The details of an error of code `C`: the typed fields of that code. While
the code is not known each field reads as `unknown`; narrow with
`isObolError(e, code)`.

```ts sdk-signature
type DetailsOf<C extends ObolErrorCode> =
  ObolErrorDetails[C] & Record<string, unknown>;
```

<p class="sdk-see"><a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/errors.ts#L30">source</a></p>

### StatusSource {#StatusSource}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">StatusSource</code></div>

Where the writes that check validator state read it from (the same
options as [`deposits.status`](../deposits.md#status)). Without either, the Obol API's
`POST /v1/validators/:network/deposit-status` is used when the client has
the API.

```ts sdk-signature
interface StatusSource {
  beaconUrl?: string;
  lockHash?: string;
  pendingRetry?: PendingRetry;
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>beaconUrl?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> | Beacon node REST URL, for the chain fallback. |
| <code>lockHash?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> | The cluster lock of the pubkeys: only needed while the Obol API does not serve the deposit-status route (the interim `GET /v1/state/:lockHash` answers by lock). |
| <code>pendingRetry?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="#PendingRetry">PendingRetry</a></span> | Re-reads of an Obol API deposit-status batch while an entry has `signaturesPending` (the API checks queued deposit signatures in the background, usually within a slot). Default `{ tries: 3, delayMs: 8000 }`: up to 3 requests, waiting 8 s then 16 s (about two slots). |

</div>
